absorb: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
acid: The foe is sprayed with a harsh, hide-melting acid that may lower DEFENSE.
acidarmor: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise DEFENSE.
agility: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its SPEED.
amnesia: Forgets about something and sharply raises SPECIAL.
aurorabeam: A rainbow-colored attack beam. It may lower the foe’s ATTACK stat.
barrage: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.
barrier: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its DEFENSE stat.
bide: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
bind: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.
bite: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
blizzard: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.
bodyslam: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
boneclub: The foe is clubbed with a bone held in hand. It may make the foe flinch.
bonemerang: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.
bubble: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe’s SPEED stat.
bubblebeam: A spray of bubbles strikes the foe. It may lower the foe’s SPEED stat.
clamp: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user’s shell for two to five turns.
cometpunch: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times.
confuseray: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
confusion: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.
constrict: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. It may lower SPEED.
conversion: The user changes its type to match the foe’s type.
counter: Strikes back at a Normal- or Fighting-type hit with double the damage.
crabhammer: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
cut: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.
defensecurl: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its DEFENSE stat.
dig: The user burrows underground on the 1st turn, then strikes on the 2nd turn.
disable: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.
dizzypunch: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.
doubleedge: A reckless, life-risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.
doublekick: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.
doubleslap: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.
doubleteam: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
dragonrage: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40-HP damage.
dreameater: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.
drillpeck: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
earthquake: A powerful quake that shakes the ground to strike the foe.
eggbomb: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.
ember: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.
explosion: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.
fireblast: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
firepunch: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the foe with a burn.
firespin: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages two to five turns.
fissure: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.
flamethrower: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.
flash: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy.
fly: The user flies up high on the 1st turn, then strikes on the 2nd turn.
focusenergy: The user takes a deep breath to focus. In this generation it actually lowers its critical-hit ratio.
furyattack: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.
furyswipes: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.
glare: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.
growl: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its ATTACK stat.
growth: The user’s body is forced to grow, raising its SPECIAL.
guillotine: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint if it hits.
gust: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.
harden: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its DEFENSE stat.
haze: Eliminates all stat changes among all Pokémon engaged in battle.
headbutt: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.
highjumpkick: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
hornattack: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
horndrill: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.
hydropump: A high volume of water is blasted at the foe under great pressure.
hyperbeam: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.
hyperfang: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
hypnosis: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.
icebeam: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.
icepunch: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the foe frozen.
jumpkick: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.
karatechop: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
kinesis: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.
leechlife: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
leechseed: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the user on every turn.
leer: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its DEFENSE stat.
lick: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyze.
lightscreen: A wall of light that halves damage from special attacks while the user stays in.
lovelykiss: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.
lowkick: A low, tripping kick. It may make the foe flinch.
meditate: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its ATTACK stat.
megadrain: A tough attack that drains half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
megakick: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.
megapunch: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
metronome: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.
mimic: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.
minimize: The user compresses all the cells in its body to raise its evasiveness.
mirrormove: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.
mist: The user is shrouded in mist that prevents its stats from being lowered.
nightshade: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
payday: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe to inflict damage.
peck: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
petaldance: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.
pinmissile: Sharp pins are shot at the foe and hit two to five times at once.
poisongas: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.
poisonpowder: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.
poisonsting: The foe is stabbed with a toxic barb, etc. It may poison the foe.
pound: A physical attack delivered with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
psybeam: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.
psychic: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s SPECIAL.
psywave: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave that varies in intensity.
quickattack: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.
rage: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.
razorleaf: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
razorwind: Blades of wind hit the foe on the 2nd turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
recover: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user’s maximum HP.
reflect: A wall of light that halves damage from physical attacks while the user stays in.
rest: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.
roar: Has no effect in a trainer battle like this one.
rockslide: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
rockthrow: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.
rollingkick: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.
sandattack: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.
scratch: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.
screech: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s DEFENSE.
seismictoss: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user’s level.
selfdestruct: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.
sharpen: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise ATTACK.
sing: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
skullbash: The user tucks in its head on the 1st turn, then rams the foe on the 2nd turn.
skyattack: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.
slam: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.
slash: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
sleeppowder: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.
sludge: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
smog: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.
smokescreen: The foe is attacked with a cloud of smoke that may lower accuracy.
softboiled: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.
solarbeam: The user absorbs light on the 1st turn, then fires a beam on the 2nd turn.
sonicboom: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 20-HP damage.
spikecannon: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times.
splash: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.
spore: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
stomp: The user stomps down on the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
strength: The foe is slugged at maximum power.
stringshot: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces SPEED.
struggle: User loses 1/2 the HP lost by the target.
stunspore: A cloud of poisonous dust is scattered. It may paralyze the foe.
submission: The user grabs the foe and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user.
substitute: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.
superfang: The user chomps hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the foe’s HP by half.
supersonic: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the foe.
surf: The user swamps the foe with a giant wave.
swift: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.
swordsdance: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK.
tackle: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.
tailwhip: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its DEFENSE stat.
takedown: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also hurts the user a little.
teleport: Has no effect in a trainer battle like this one.
thrash: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused.
thunder: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also paralyze.
thunderbolt: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also paralyze.
thunderpunch: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
thundershock: An electric shock is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also paralyze.
thunderwave: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It is paralyzed if it hits.
toxic: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
transform: The user transforms into a copy of the foe, even copying the foe’s genetic code.
triattack: Fires three types of beams at the same time. It may cause a burn, freeze, or paralysis.
twineedle: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.
vinewhip: The foe is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
visegrip: The foe is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
waterfall: A powerful charge attack. It may make the foe flinch.
watergun: The foe is struck with a lot of water expelled forcibly from the mouth.
whirlwind: Has no effect in a trainer battle like this one.
wingattack: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
withdraw: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its DEFENSE.
wrap: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.
dragonclaw: Rakes the foe with sharp, dragon-like claws.
dragonbreath: Blasts the foe with a dragon's breath. May paralyze.
twister: Whips up a vicious twister. May make the foe flinch.
outrage: Rampages for 2-3 turns, then becomes confused.
dragonpulse: Fires a shock wave from the mouth.
shadowball: Hurls a shadowy blob. May lower the foe's SPECIAL.
shadowpunch: A punch from the shadows that never misses.
rocktomb: Drops boulders on the foe. Lowers its SPEED.
ancientpower: Attacks with a mysterious, ancient force.
stoneedge: Stabs with sharp stones. High critical-hit ratio.
signalbeam: Fires an odd beam of light. May confuse the foe.
xscissor: Slashes the foe with crossed claws.
megahorn: Charges with a tough, enormous horn.
mudshot: Hurls a blob of mud. Lowers the foe's SPEED.
bonerush: Strikes with a bone 2 to 5 times in a row.
earthpower: Makes the ground erupt. May lower the foe's SPECIAL.
heatwave: Exhales a hot breath. May burn the foe.
icywind: A chilling wind that lowers the foe's SPEED.
spark: An electrified tackle. May paralyze the foe.
crosschop: A double chop. High critical-hit ratio.
aerialace: An extremely fast attack that never misses.
poisonjab: Stabs with a poisonous tentacle or arm. May poison.
